faqs.a:
(a)
It is hereby declared to be a nuisance and shall be unlawful for any person to keep,
               pasture, house, or maintain in the city any hogs, pigs, or swine, except pot-bellied
               pigs as set forth below.
(b)
It shall be unlawful for any person to keep, pasture, house, maintain, or harbor a
               pot-bellied pig within the city unless the owner or custodian registers said pot-bellied
               pig with the animal management office within 14 days of acquiring said pig and complies
               with the following requirements:
(1)
Male pot-bellied pigs must be castrated prior to the age of four months and female
               pot-bellied pigs must be spayed prior to the age of four months.
(2)
Pot-bellied pigs must wear an identification tag at all times and be tattooed prior
               to the age of four months.
(3)
Notice of completion of the requirements of subsections (1) and (2) of this section
               must be on file with the animal management office as a requirement of registration.
(4)
All pot-bellied pigs must wear a harness except when inside the owner's or custodian's
               home or dwelling.
(c)
It is hereby declared to be a nuisance, and it shall be unlawful for any person to
               keep, pasture, or maintain in the city any pot-bellied pig weighing more than 70 pounds.
(Code 1981, § 6-48; Ord. No. 3496, § 2, 12-14-1998)
